[name="老鲤"] 我说过吗？
[Character(name="avg_322_lmlee_1#4$1", name2="avg_1021_kroos2_1#10$1", focus=2)]
[name="克洛丝"] 说过的。相处下来之后，我是觉得一点都不像……
[Character(name="avg_322_lmlee_1#8$1", name2="avg_1021_kroos2_1#10$1", focus=1)]
[name="老鲤"] 嗯……
[Character(name="avg_322_lmlee_1#10$1", name2="avg_1021_kroos2_1#10$1", focus=1)]
[name="老鲤"] 毕竟……都被心上人吃得死死的啊。
